name: nixconvoy
description: Subagent worktrees under the spawning checkout, each owning a nixconvoy work branch; every subagent spawned in a repository given one (isolation: worktree) unless the option says not to

isolate_subagents.title: Isolate subagents
isolate_subagents.description: Add isolation: worktree to every Agent call spawned inside a git repository that did not set one. Turn off when a PreToolUse hook of your own rewrites Agent calls: Claude Code keeps one hook's rewrite, so that hook must add the isolation itself.
